# CANDIDATE: BASELINE_EDGE_CAPTURE_CHECK

**Filed:** 2026-08-24
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** quality_gate
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

We hypothesize that the current production engine (v15.3 Safe) achieves an edge_capture of at least $771 (50% of max possible $1542) on J's source-of-truth anchor days (4/29, 5/01, 5/04 winners and 5/05, 5/06, 5/07 losers) when evaluated via Stage-1 backtest with real OPRA fills, walk-forward OOS test (WF≥0.70), and real-fills validation on top 3 J days (<±20% vs BS-sim).

## Mechanism

Run the autoresearch grinder harness Stage-1 backtest on the current engine configuration (params.json as of filing date). Compute equity curve, win rate, profit factor, edge_capture on each J anchor day, aggregate Sharpe, walk-forward OOS test (WF ratio), real-fills validation on the top 3 J days (4/29, 5/01, 5/04) comparing BS-sim vs realistic OPRA fill simulator, and concentration disclosure (top-5 days % of P&L). No changes to engine logic; this is a measurement only.

## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** qty=28 requires $25K+ account; $1K paper ~= 14% headline P&L scaling.
2. **Sample bias:** Stage-1 backtest uses full 16-month OPRA cache (2025-01-02..2026-06-18) with no look-ahead bias; selection method is all days in sample; overfit risk mitigated by walk-forward OOS test and real-fills validation.
3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS (walk-forward held-out window to be computed during Stage-1 backtest).
4. **Real-fills:** NEEDS-REAL-FILLS (realistic OPRA fill simulation to be run on top 3 J days).
5. **Failure modes:** Worst day could be a large loser on J loser days; max drawdown unknown; blow-up scenario if edge_capture < 0 and leverage triggers daily loss kill switch.
6. **Concentration:** unknown -- requires Stage-1 backtest to compute top-5 days % of P&L.

## Pre-merge gate

- Gym validators: all strategy/tests must pass.
- Walk-forward OOS ratio ≥ 0.70.
- Real-fills validation on top 3 J days: simulated P&L difference < ±20% vs BS-sim.
- Edge_capture ≥ 771.
- Concentration disclosure: top-5 days % reported.
